name: Tú no eres la princesa
source:
Step into the story loop! Possess the princess's body and make the story continue infinitely!

Created just for you, experience pure decadence!

[Translated from [url=https://ryu-san.itch.io/tu-no-eres-la-princesa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏入故事的循環！附身於公主，讓故事永無止境地繼續下去！

只為你而打造，來體驗徹頭徹尾的頹靡吧！

［譯自[url=https://ryu-san.itch.io/tu-no-eres-la-princesa]Itch.io[/url]］
